The '''HR-0C Slingshot slug railgun''' was a type of slug [[Railgun/Legends|rail gun]] produced by [[Balmorran Arms/Legends|Balmorran Arms]] during the [[Galactic War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]]. A relatively simple rail gun, the Slingshot had incredible range and fired metal projectiles that partially bypassed a target's shield, dealing severe damage to enemy [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighters]].<ref name="Starfighter" />
